## Responsibility

`RuleEngine` port on Biome: canon rules bound to `biome:lint/<group>/<rule>` are verified against the installed Biome and checked through its SARIF reporter.

## Invariants

- A repository without a Biome config is never linted with Biome's defaults [[cite: packages/plugin-biome/src/biome-engine.ts:81 | "if (!CONFIG_FILES.some((f) => existsSync(join(this.root, f)))) return ok([]);"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` only; Biome itself is the user's dev dependency, found in their `node_modules` (ADR-0025).

## Pitfalls

- Use the SARIF reporter, not `json`: the JSON reporter is experimental and changes in patch releases.
- `--max-diagnostics=none`, otherwise Biome stops after 20 findings and the check looks cleaner than it is.
